research.topic: Most Rugby World Cup titles: South Africa 4 (1995, 2007, 2019, 2023); New Zealand 3 (1987, 2011, 2015); Australia 2 (1991, 1999); England 1 (2003). 1995 final at Ellis Park, Johannesburg; 2023 final at Stade de France, Saint-Denis, Paris: South Africa 12–11 New Zealand.

myths.myth: New Zealand has won the most Rugby World Cups because the All Blacks are the dominant team.
myths.reality: South Africa has four titles to New Zealand's three after beating the All Blacks 12–11 in the 2023 final.
